scenario: Admitted 3 nights for pneumonia; policy 2 years old.
summary: The claim for pneumonia hospitalisation is likely covered as the policy is 2 years old and there are no specific exclusions for pneumonia.

scenario: Hospitalised for dengue; policy started 15 days ago.
summary: The claim for dengue hospitalisation is not covered due to the initial waiting period of 30 days.

scenario: Broke a leg in a road accident; policy is 10 days old.
summary: The claim for a broken leg in a road accident is likely covered as it is an accidental injury and does not fall under any waiting period.

scenario: Diabetic for 5 years; admitted for a diabetes complication; policy 12 months old.
summary: The claim for diabetes complication is not covered due to the pre-existing disease waiting period.

scenario: Cataract surgery; policy 18 months old.
summary: Cataract surgery is excluded due to the specific illness waiting period not being met.

scenario: Cataract surgery; policy 3 years old.
summary: Cataract surgery is likely covered under this policy as it has been more than 24 months since the policy commencement date.

scenario: Father, 65, admitted for cardiac care; policy 4 years old.
summary: The claim for cardiac care is likely covered under the policy, with some potential limits and co-payments applicable.

scenario: Chose a deluxe room costing above 1% of the sum insured.
summary: The claim for a deluxe room costing above 1% of the sum insured is not covered due to the room rent cap.

scenario: Elective cosmetic nose reshaping.
summary: Elective cosmetic nose reshaping is excluded from coverage as it is not necessitated by an accident, burn, or cancer.

scenario: Reconstructive surgery after a burn injury.
summary: Reconstructive surgery after a burn injury is likely covered under this policy as it is considered a necessary treatment following an accident or burn, which is an exception to the exclusion on cosmetic or plastic surgery.

scenario: Root canal at the dentist; no accident involved.
summary: Dental treatment is excluded unless necessitated by an accident and requiring hospitalisation.

scenario: Jaw surgery with hospitalisation after a road accident.
summary: Jaw surgery with hospitalisation after a road accident is likely covered under the policy.

scenario: Admitted one day only for tests; no active treatment given.
summary: The claim is not covered because the hospitalisation was primarily for diagnostic purposes with no active treatment given.

scenario: Cataract done as a day-care procedure (<24 hrs); policy 3 years old.
summary: The cataract surgery done as a day-care procedure is likely covered under the policy.

scenario: Normal delivery; policy 30 months old.
summary: Normal delivery is covered after 24 months of continuous coverage, which is met in this scenario.

scenario: Delivery; policy 12 months old.
summary: The claim for delivery is not covered because the policy is only 12 months old and the maternity waiting period is 24 months.

scenario: Ambulance bill of Rs 3,500.
summary: The ambulance bill exceeds the covered limit of Rs. 2,000 per hospitalisation.

scenario: Inpatient Ayurvedic treatment at a recognised hospital.
summary: Inpatient Ayurvedic treatment at a recognised hospital is covered under the policy.

scenario: Rehab for alcohol dependence.
summary: Rehab for alcohol dependence is excluded from coverage under this policy.

scenario: Injury from a suicide attempt.
summary: Injury from a suicide attempt is excluded from coverage under the policy.

scenario: Cost of new prescription glasses.
summary: The cost of new prescription glasses is excluded from coverage under the policy.

scenario: Diagnostic tests 20 days before admission.
summary: Diagnostic tests 20 days before admission are likely covered under the pre-hospitalisation expenses.

scenario: Medicines bought 75 days after discharge.
summary: Medicines bought 75 days after discharge are not covered because they exceed the 60-day post-hospitalisation window.
